description: Storm ground reports: NWS Local Storm Reports (hail, wind, tornado, flood ground reports from spotters, officials and the public) within a radius of a coordinate over up to 365 days, from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive of NWS LSRs (free, no key). Source: NWS LSR via IEM. Not a damage determination. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: summary{hail, wind, tornado, flood, days}, reports[{ts, type_text, magnitude, unit, city, county, source, remark, distance_km}].
name: x420_storm_reports
